title: Webhooks
intro: Notify the destination configured by the server about page changes, creation, movement and trash actions. Server administrator approval and a subscription by a page manager are required.
signInHint: Sign in with a verified account.
accountChanged: The account changed. Actions are stopped. Sign in again to review.
denied: Your current permissions do not allow this action. The selected page display has been stopped.
conflict: The state changed first. Your review is retained. Reload the status and review again.
uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. Nothing was resent automatically. Reload the status to check.
unavailable: Status could not be loaded. Check the server configuration or connection.
disabled: Webhooks are disabled in the environment configuration.
label: Profile label
envOnly: Destination URLs and keys are managed through the environment. This screen neither changes nor displays them.
metadataHint: Only metadata for the displayed event types is sent. Events distinguish title and document changes, without including the title, document, properties, email addresses, attachments or comments.
adminOnly: Only server administrators named in the environment can approve. Page access and management permissions are separate.
approveConsent: I approve transferring metadata for the displayed event types to the displayed destination.
approvedDone: Administrator approval saved. Page subscriptions are configured separately.
revokeHint: This ends subscriptions for the profile and cancels queued notifications. Already sent notifications cannot be recalled.
choosePage: Choose a page you can manage
selectHint: Only pages you can manage are available. Child pages are not included automatically.
noPage: Select a target page to review its status.
reasonAuthority: Page structure, management or membership changed
quotaHint: Saving a note still succeeds at notification capacity. The subscription pauses and queued notifications are cancelled. If retained notification metadata is full, operator maintenance is required.
lifetimeHint: The issuer’s management permission, membership generation, administrator approval and destination profile are checked each time. Rejoining or changing the destination does not reactivate old subscriptions. Large changes pause notifications and require reviewing the gap before resuming.
subscribeTitle: Start a subscription for this page
metadataConsent: I consent to sending page IDs, event types, versions and times within the scope shown to this destination.
scopeDescendants: Selected page and descendants the issuer can currently manage
descendantConsent: I consent to notifications for current and future descendants only while the issuer can manage them. No sharing permissions are added.
resumeHint: A new subscription generation starts from the current page version. Missed and earlier notifications are not replayed.
gapConsent: I understand that missing notifications will not be replayed and will arrange any needed review separately.
subscriptionSaved: The subscription starts now. Earlier changes will not be sent.
stopHint: Future and queued notifications are cancelled. An in-flight or already accepted notification may not be recalled.
deliveriesHint: Shows up to the latest 50 notifications. “Destination returned 2xx” does not guarantee processing completed there. Failures and timeouts can result in retries of the same event.
profileChanged: The destination state changed. Reload and review it again.
INTEGRITY: Sending stopped because notification data integrity could not be verified.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
configuredEvents: Events selected in the environment configuration
eventType.page.updated: When the title or document changes
eventType.page.created: When a descendant is created (descendant scope required)
eventType.page.moved: When the parent changes, within the current subscription scope
eventType.page.trashed: When moved to trash, with current management permission checked
